account: Today appears quiet, though I have little confirmed news. During my scheduled morning market walk, several townsfolk said they had no news. I called to the builder for an update on town works, but have not heard a reply. Curiously, Townsfolk 08 and 18 later repeated my exact request to the builder; I do not know whether they were passing it along or why they repeated it. The secretary initially reported no correspondence or urgent reports. My appointment book lists tea at an unspecified east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, and I asked the secretary to establish the host and address. The secretary came to my home during lunch holding a writable book. I asked for news and confirmation, but any subsequent words were out of earshot as I returned to town hall. Thus I cannot say that the tea address is confirmed or what the secretary's book contains. It is now 13:02, and I have reached town hall for the scheduled town accounts. The innkeeper and three townsfolk are outside; their presence alone gives me no reason to infer any special gathering. My remaining appointments are tea at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00.
